title: Release SemVer receipt envelope (v1)
description: Transport envelope that binds one evidence pack, the independent rater observations collected through orchestrator/free, and an unmodified fast-mlsirm calibrated release-decision receipt. contextual-orchestrator never produces or interprets a release decision: the only decision authority is fast_mlsirm_receipt.document, which is carried unchanged and bound by schema_id and sha256. The envelope deliberately has no outcome, decision or version field of its own.
$comment: Immutable once released: any change requires a new vN directory and MANIFEST entry. Resolve every $ref from the packaged schema files through a local registry; never retrieve a $id over the network. Consumers must also reject documents larger than 4194304 UTF-8 bytes. Patterns avoid \s and guard the end of string explicitly, so ECMA-262 and Python re validators agree (Python's $ also matches before a final newline).

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact evidence and observation schema file bytes used, as listed in MANIFEST.json.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON form of the evidence pack.

evidence_source_commit.description: Source commit the evidence pack was collected at. Kept here, not in the #2260-shaped pack.

model_pool.description: The only admissible pool. No provider, model, or group selection is representable.

package_version.description: Version of the installed contextual-orchestrator release that produced this envelope (producer identity, not a release decision).

served_route.description: Route identity reported by the gateway for this observation, never by the model. route must be orchestrator/free; agent_id, model and provider are recorded for audit only and are never a caller selection. Step 2 checks them against the gateway's route report and the free-pool catalogue.

fast_mlsirm_receipt.description: The fast-mlsirm calibrated release-decision receipt, carried unchanged and never interpreted by contextual-orchestrator. document is the sole decision authority; sha256 is the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON form, which consumers must recompute.

schema_id.description: fast-mlsirm's receipt schema identifier, in one of two forms: a URI (RFC 3986 characters only) or fast-mlsirm's dotted form (fast-mlsirm.<name>.v<N>, as in fast-mlsirm.sampling-design.v1). Names are lowercase letters and digits joined by - or _, so spaces, =, ; and other free text do not fit the dotted form. The hyphenated form (fast-mlsirm-<name>-v<N>) is intentionally not accepted in v1. The pattern does not stop verdict-looking URIs; step 2 check receipt_schema_id admits only an identity listed in the installed MANIFEST.json receipt_schema_id_allowlist, which stays empty until step 4, so every envelope is rejected until fast-mlsirm publishes its receipt identity.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256. Repeated-digit placeholders (for example all zeros) are rejected; this is cosmetic, and integrity comes from the step 2 digest checks.

commit.description: Exact 40-character lowercase Git commit id. Degenerate repeated-digit values are rejected.

gateway_identifier.description: Identifier reported by the gateway: letters, digits and . _ : / @ + - only, so key=value or sentence text does not fit. Step 2 checks it against the gateway's route report and the free-pool catalogue.

provider_name.description: Provider name reported by the gateway, such as openrouter or nvidia_nim: lowercase letters, digits and . _ - only (no model path, no :variant).
